freshness_requirements.additional_requirement: Exact build, configuration, identity, schedule, or evidence-set binding; the offline 31536000-second KAT horizon is not a production lifetime.
Recheck exact endpoint, profile, region, namespace, TLS, and track at decision.
Recheck exact lease scope and prove zero active lease commitments at decision.
Recheck exact resource scope, cost ceiling, budget owner, and auto-stop policy at decision.
Recheck signed trusted time, maximum skew, row epoch, and currentness at decision.
Bind the exact runner build and retain the independent emergency-stop drill identity.
Bind the exact storage policy and retain replay, cleanup, and tombstone identities.
Decision must occur before min(final validation + 1800 seconds, every bounded evidence expiry) with an unchanged set hash.

owner_handoff_requirements.requirement: All fifteen prerequisite evidence entries are authenticated and production validated.
Independent review binds ordered validated entries 1-14 in the production review-subject domain.
Owner handoff binds ordered validated entries 1-15 in a separate production owner-set domain.
The final validation and owner decision use exactly the same immutable validated set hash.
Final validation time is supplied by the bound signed trusted-time source.
Owner decision occurs strictly less than 1800 seconds after final validation.
Effective owner deadline is the minimum of the owner window and every bounded evidence expiry.
All decision-time rechecks pass without changing content, validation receipt, or set hash.
Owner identity, role, audience, signature, and single-use decision authority are authenticated.
A separate successor production owner schema is required because the current schema cannot represent approval.

production_ingestion_controls.mandatory_check: Reject over-limit, non-UTF-8, BOM, trailing bytes, duplicate keys, non-finite numbers, compression, and remote references.
production_ingestion_controls.required_future_artifact: Production framing limits, duplicate-safe decoder, and bounded quarantine contract.

production_ingestion_controls.mandatory_check: Reject every synthetic packet kind and synthetic hash domain at any future production entry.
production_ingestion_controls.required_future_artifact: Distinct production schema, packet kind, canonicalization, and domain-separated hashes.

production_ingestion_controls.mandatory_check: Verify a separately configured bootstrap trust root, signer chain, exact key version, role, and revocation state.
production_ingestion_controls.required_future_artifact: Bootstrap verifier and external trust-root, key-version, role, and revocation policy.

production_ingestion_controls.mandatory_check: Authorize signer identity to the exact owner class, evidence class, track, subject, audience, and nonce scope.
production_ingestion_controls.required_future_artifact: Signer authorization registry scoped to owner class, evidence class, track, and subject.

production_ingestion_controls.mandatory_check: Bind prerequisite, provider or lab profile, namespace, build, configuration, subject, and non-substitutable track.
production_ingestion_controls.required_future_artifact: Provider and lab identity registry with exact profile, namespace, build, and configuration bindings.

production_ingestion_controls.mandatory_check: Record distinct immutable raw-byte and canonical-payload hashes in bounded quarantine and append-only custody.
production_ingestion_controls.required_future_artifact: Append-only custody store retaining raw, canonical, validation, retention, and tombstone identities.

production_ingestion_controls.mandatory_check: Apply exact schema, payload, dependency, subject, profile, provenance, and rejection-reason validation.
production_ingestion_controls.required_future_artifact: Production semantic validator preserving exact prerequisite-specific failure reasons.

production_ingestion_controls.mandatory_check: Use signed trusted time, half-open observed <= checked < expires arithmetic, skew limits, and decision-time rechecks.
production_ingestion_controls.required_future_artifact: Signed trusted-time source, skew policy, expiry arithmetic, and decision recheck receipt.

production_ingestion_controls.mandatory_check: Atomically reserve issuer, nonce or sequence, and raw hash in a durable linearizable single-use ledger.
production_ingestion_controls.required_future_artifact: Durable linearizable replay ledger with atomic CAS and idempotent same-byte receipt lookup.

production_ingestion_controls.mandatory_check: Bind evidence hash, validator build and configuration, signed check time, track, prerequisite, and disposition.
production_ingestion_controls.required_future_artifact: Signed validation receipt schema bound to validator build, configuration, time, and evidence identity.

production_ingestion_controls.mandatory_check: Bind independent reviewer identity and role to validated entries 1-14 plus validator build and configuration.
production_ingestion_controls.required_future_artifact: Independent-review signature over the production review-subject set and validator identity.

production_ingestion_controls.mandatory_check: Derive a separate ordered production owner set from validated entries 1-15; never reuse the synthetic set domain.
production_ingestion_controls.required_future_artifact: Domain-separated production owner-handoff set over ordered validated entries 1-15.

production_ingestion_controls.mandatory_check: Bind owner identity, role, signature, final-validation revision, same-set hash, and effective decision deadline.
production_ingestion_controls.required_future_artifact: Authenticated owner decision schema and single-use same-set decision window.

production_ingestion_controls.mandatory_check: Commit one owner decision by atomic CAS and keep all four downstream gates independently unauthorized.
production_ingestion_controls.required_future_artifact: Atomic owner-decision ledger plus four separately evaluated downstream gate contracts.

threat_cases.mutation: Oversized or malformed envelope, BOM, trailing bytes, compression, or remote reference
Duplicate JSON key, non-finite number, excessive depth, or alternate encoding
Synthetic validator-double packet presented to a production boundary
Unknown production schema, version, packet kind, or hash domain
Invalid signature, untrusted root, wrong key version, or revoked signer
Signer role is not authorized for owner class, evidence class, track, or subject
Managed and self-hosted packet, profile, namespace, or configuration substitution
Prerequisite, source, build, session, channel, schedule, row set, or subject mismatch
Raw hash, canonical hash, packet ID, signature subject, or validation subject mismatch
Evidence is stale at validation or at the required decision-time recheck
Evidence is future dated or trusted-time skew exceeds the bound
Evidence expires or set contents change after final validation and before owner decision
Previously reserved issuer nonce, sequence, or packet identity is submitted again
Concurrent submissions race a non-atomic replay check
Missing, duplicated, reordered, or substituted validated entry 1-14
Owner handoff omits, duplicates, reorders, or changes validated entry 1-15
Raw, canonical, validation, retention, cleanup, or tombstone chain diverges
Reviewer identity is not independent or validator build/config binding drifts
Owner identity, role, signature, same-set hash, revision, or deadline mismatch
Positive decision attempted before all production controls and fifteen evidence entries validate

trust_domains.purpose: Exact frozen synthetic KAT packet-set identity; offline conformance only.
Future signed production evidence envelopes; never reusable by the synthetic domain.
Future ordered validated entries 1-14 for independent review.
Future ordered validated entries 1-15 for owner handoff.
Future owner identity, role, same-set decision, and single-use signature.
